Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited consolidated financial statements for 2024 and 2025. The Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners were granted a full discharge of responsibility for the 2025 fiscal year.
Agenda #2: The meeting resolved not to distribute dividends for the 2025 fiscal year, instead allocating Rp1 billion to reserves and the remainder to retained earnings. These funds are designated for the company's business development.
Agenda #3: Authority was granted to the Board of Commissioners to appoint a public accountant for the 2026 fiscal year audit and determine their honorarium. The Board is also authorized to appoint a replacement if the selected firm cannot fulfill its duties.
Agenda #4: The Board of Commissioners was authorized to determine the 2026 salaries, honorariums, and allowances for the Board of Directors and Board of Commissioners. This determination must consider recommendations from the Nomination and Remuneration Committee.
Agenda #5: Michell Suharli and Hadi Cahyadi were appointed as Independent Commissioners, and the full composition of 11 Directors and 5 Commissioners was established with terms ending in June 2031. The board includes President Director Timotius M. Sulaiman and President Commissioner M. Arsjad Rasjid P.M.
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved pledging more than 50% of the company's net assets as collateral for loan facilities from domestic or foreign financial institutions. This approval allows the company to secure necessary financing from various financial institutions.
Agenda #7: Shareholders approved amending Article 3 of the Articles of Association to comply with KBLI 2025 regulations. The Board was authorized to perform all necessary actions to implement these changes, including signing documents and obtaining ministerial approval.
